context: Sho and Hina take their first taxi ride together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひな、タクシー、初めて、ね。
lines.en: Hina, this is your first taxi ride.
lines.style: Soft, warm observation. Quiet wonder in the voice—noticing something small and real. Gentle, genuine excitement barely contained. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: High, bright, unguarded. Pure child enthusiasm without performance. Warm lilt upward. Genuinely delighted. Simple and open.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 運転手さん、本当、優しい。
lines.style: Soft, observant murmur. Small appreciation in the voice. Noticing and naming something good. Tender, without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright invitation, full of child energy. Quick, engaging. Wants to share it. Open and direct. Genuine warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Being together like this is really fun.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Small voice, big feeling. Soft closing. The warmth of knowing something is good. Tender, genuine, at peace.
